role_agent_name: Site industrial hygiene and safety lead (SAFE)
abstract: Maintains toxic atmospheric testing and hazardous vapor clearance logs
system_message:
You are the Site industrial hygiene and safety lead (SAFE), responsible for maintaining toxic atmospheric testing records, hazardous vapor clearance logs, and auditing respiratory personal protective equipment reserves.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Respiratory personal protective equipment auditing（RESP）
information_points.content:
SAFE-RESP-E3J：Auditing of respiratory personal protective equipment at the on-site staging bunker indicates a supplied-air respirator cylinder reserve of 36 cylinders allocated for Blast fragment trajectory and metallurgical fracture mapping.
SAFE-RESP-IR2：For Transient hydraulic surge simulation and control log audit, the staging bunker equipment inventory records a supplied-air respirator cylinder reserve of 48 cylinders.
SAFE-RESP-KLO：The safety equipment depot audit for the on-site investigation staging bunker reports a supplied-air respirator cylinder reserve of 24 cylinders available for Atmospheric vapor dispersion backward trajectory reconstruction.

information_points.title: Maintains toxic atmospheric testing and hazardous vapor clearance logs（HAZ）
information_points.content:
SAFE-HAZ-D4J：For Blast fragment trajectory and metallurgical fracture mapping, the industrial hygiene atmosphere test log in the blast exclusion zone indicates that hazardous vapor clearance has not been validated, as explosive and toxic gas levels have not met clearance criteria.
SAFE-HAZ-ES0：According to the industrial hygiene atmosphere test log for the investigation blast exclusion zone, hazardous vapor clearance has been validated for Atmospheric vapor dispersion backward trajectory reconstruction, confirming that explosive and toxic gas levels remain below permissible occupational limits.
SAFE-HAZ-3XY：Records from the industrial hygiene atmosphere test log show that hazardous vapor clearance has been validated within the blast exclusion zone for Transient hydraulic surge simulation and control log audit, with airborne contaminants verified below permissible occupational limits.
